note: Every pin here must be resolvable from an official source. `resolvedAt` records when the version was resolved; `minAgeDays` is the policy minimum age for a version to be considered stable enough to pin. `node scripts/resolve-versions.mjs --check` verifies the npm pins still exist and reports newer stable releases without changing anything.

tools.purpose: Run the prototype in a real browser, screenshot every screen/state per viewport, dump DOM geometry
tools.install: npm i -D playwright@1.64.1 && npx playwright install chromium
tools.notes: Chromium download (~150 MB) only works on a machine with open egress to cdn.playwright.dev. In a sandbox without it, capture is CI-only (see docs/PLAN.md decision D3). Pinned to 1.64.1 (published 2026-10-14) rather than 1.65.1 (2026-11-13) because the repository policy requires a version that has been public for at least two weeks.

tools.purpose: Anti-aliasing-aware pixel diff percentage and heat map
Pure-JS PNG decode/encode so the diff stack runs on Windows, macOS and Linux with no native build
SSIM structural similarity score per screen
tools.notes: plain JS, no native deps — chosen over sharp/opencv for cross-platform determinism

tools.purpose: Frontmatter / workflow / config validation in scripts and tests
Compose screenshot tests on the JVM (Robolectric) so screens can be rendered and diffed on any machine, including CI without an emulator
tools.notes: Default choice. Pure JVM, works with the project's own Compose version, no emulator, and supports capturing explicit `@Config(qualifiers=...)` sizes. Known gap: blur/backdrop-filter effects may render differently or not at all under Robolectric (see docs/LIMITS.md). Fallback: Paparazzi when the project is Android-only and does not need Robolectric-specific features. Pin verified against https://api.github.com/repos/takahirom/roborazzi/releases on 2026-11-16 (1.79.0, published 2026-11-12); Robolectric 4.17 is the matching test runtime.

tools.purpose: Fallback JVM screenshot tool (layoutlib-based) for Android-only projects
tools.notes: Pinned version must be re-resolved at run time against the project's AGP major; layoutlib is AGP-coupled and breaks across AGP majors.

tools.purpose: Third option: Google's preview screenshot testing plugin (AGP-coupled, alpha)
tools.notes: Alpha and AGP-version-locked; not the default because the target project's AGP (9.5.0) is ahead of the published plugin. Kept as an option, version resolved at run time.

tools.purpose: Fast Kotlin format/lint check used by the PostToolUse hook (single file only)
Deeper Kotlin static analysis in the verify step (never in a hook)
Convert prototype SVG assets into Compose ImageVector / vector drawables (Valkyrie or svg2vector tooling)
tools.notes: Valkyrie is an IDE plugin, not a CLI. Default path is a script-based conversion of the small SVG subset the prototype uses (paths, circles, ellipses, groups) into ImageVector code; the IDE plugin is offered when the user has Android Studio.

tools.purpose: Token-saving code simplification plugin (optional, on demand)
tools.notes: Simplification can erase pixel-level detail. Useful for engine-side work and reviews.
